title: Policy column has no index
issue: The policy filters on org_id but nothing indexes it; the column never appears in application queries, so nobody notices.
symptom: naive_rls (no index) is a Seq Scan for every statement, even PK-free selective queries; the indexed variants use Index/Bitmap scans on org_id.

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents (100 docs per org, scale/20 users)
